RUPEE STRENGTHENS 17 PAISE TO 93.15 AGAINST US DOLLAR

On 20 November 2026 the rupee strengthened to 93.15 per US dollar, gaining 17 paise in early trade after opening at 93.25.
The rise was backed by strong foreign fund inflows into Indian equities, showing resilience even as crude oil prices rose and stock market sentiment stayed negative.
